The encoder's 120 LayerNorm inputs are scaled by 2^-k (eps by 4^-k, k 3-9; bit-identical in fp32) so fp16-storage paths (the HTP, GPU fp16 arithmetic) stay finite. Text = the token ids decoded with the repo's tokenizer.json (the TDT decode: repeated ids kept).
